common: CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET for a photoreal medieval war-fantasy drama, one single wide sheet on a plain neutral mid-grey seamless background, no scenery. Photoreal cinematic portrait photography, ARRI Alexa look, soft organic rendering, fine 35mm grain, true-to-skin texture with pores and imperfections; never CGI, never illustration, never anime. A distinctive, specific, non-idealized face that is clearly the SAME person in every panel; do not beautify, do not average into a generic model face; not resembling any real actor or celebrity. Clean layout with small neat English labels. Panels: front head-and-shoulders (neutral expression), three-quarter head-and-shoulders, clean side profile, back of head and shoulders, full-body natural standing pose, one signature-expression close-up, wardrobe fabric/texture close-ups, signature props, hands detail, and a small color palette swatch row.

ELARA.prompt: Character: ELARA VAREN, 23-year-old woman, border-village healer. Face: oval face with slightly asymmetric dark eyebrows (left one higher), narrow tired dark-brown eyes with faint shadows beneath, a small pale scar at the outer corner of the left eye, straight nose with a slight bump, dry lips, light olive skin with faint freckles across the nose, ash smudges. Hair: dark brown, self-cut with a knife, ragged and uneven — right side jaw-length, left side noticeably shorter just below the ear, blunt jagged ends. Body: lean, slight, 165 cm, capable working hands. Signature expression: restrained, jaw set, eyes steady and wary. Wardrobe arc shown as three outfits side by side, labeled STAGE 1 / STAGE 2 / STAGE 3: STAGE 1 undyed oatmeal linen dress with sleeves rolled up and a worn dark-brown leather healer's apron with pockets (bandage rolls, herb pouches); STAGE 2 the same dress under a deep rust-brown hooded travel cloak; STAGE 3 simple ash-white linen tunic and wrap, no ornament. Props: small medical knife with a worn bone handle carrying a hand-carved inscription; linen bandage roll; herb pouch. Hands detail: herb-stained green-brown fingertips, short nails, a faint burn mark on the right palm. Palette swatches: oatmeal linen, dark leather brown, rust, ash white, single ember-amber accent.

RIVEN.prompt: Character: RIVEN SKAEL, 27-year-old man, northern army commander. Face: long angular face with high cheekbones and a strong jaw, deep-set grey-blue eyes, heavy straight brows, a thin vertical scar through the right eyebrow, slightly crooked once-broken nose, wind-weathered fair skin with reddened cheeks from cold, faint stubble. Hair: dark-blond, cropped short and practical. Body: tall 186 cm, broad-shouldered, upright military posture. Signature expression: unreadable, controlled stillness, eyes assessing. Wardrobe arc shown as three outfits side by side, labeled STAGE 1 / STAGE 2 / STAGE 3: STAGE 1 matte blue-grey steel plate (pauldrons, cuirass) over dark navy wool, dark fur-trimmed cloak, a small embroidered white-wolf emblem on the chest; STAGE 2 same gear with the wolf emblem torn off leaving loose threads, mismatched scavenged pieces, no cloak clasp; STAGE 3 plain undyed grey-brown wool coat, no insignia, no armor. Props: long plain-hilted sword; a dry heel of dark bread in a coat pocket; a sealed letter with a wax seal. Hands detail: leather gauntlets, beneath them scarred knuckles. Palette swatches: blue-grey steel, navy, dark fur brown, undyed wool grey, single white accent.

TORVAL.prompt: Character: TORVAL, mid-40s northern lieutenant. Face: broad square weathered face, short coarse grey beard, small watchful pale eyes under heavy lids, a notch missing from the top of the left ear, deep forehead lines. Hair: grey, close-cropped. Body: thick-set, broad, 178 cm, solid stance. Signature expression: grim, skeptical, waiting. Wardrobe: dented blue-grey steel over navy wool, heavy dark fur-lined cloak, small white-wolf emblem, sword belt. Props: hand resting on sword hilt, worn whetstone on a cord. Palette swatches: steel, navy, dark fur, grey.

CHILD.prompt: Character: a 7-year-old village girl refugee, fully clothed, wholesome family-drama character design. Face: round face, large dark eyes, small chapped lips, a little sooty smudge on one cheek, short tangled light-brown hair. Body: small and thin. Signature expression: quiet, wide-eyed, trying to remember something. Wardrobe: plain brown wool dress, an oversized faded mustard-and-grey knitted shawl wrapped around her shoulders, worn small leather shoes. Props: the shawl's frayed edge clutched in one hand. Palette swatches: brown wool, faded mustard, grey.

ELDER.prompt: Character: an elderly refugee man around 70. Face: gaunt long face, hollow cheeks, wispy white beard, cloudy pale eyes, deep wrinkles, a large mole on the right cheekbone. Hair: thin white hair under a felt cap. Body: stooped, thin. Signature expression: weary warning, mouth tight. Wardrobe: patched brown wool coat, rope belt, felt cap. Props: crooked wooden walking stick, a cloth bundle tied on his back. Palette swatches: brown, faded green, white.

SOLDIER.prompt: Character: a young wounded northern soldier around 19. Face: boyish narrow face, pale clammy skin, sandy-blond hair matted with sweat, pale blue eyes, chipped front tooth, a cut on the lower lip. Body: lanky. Signature expression: fear masked as defiance. Wardrobe: torn dark navy wool tunic, dented blue-grey breastplate with a small white-wolf emblem, a bloodied linen bandage around his left side. Palette swatches: navy, blue-grey, linen white.
